title: Average cost of a deterministic tree
statement: Let a finite input alphabet, a probability distribution on it, and a deterministic decision tree computing a function be given. The randomized decision tree that selects this deterministic tree with probability one has average query cost equal to the deterministic tree’s average query cost.
hypotheses_covered: A probability distribution on the input alphabet
A deterministic decision tree computing the specified function
